steps.instruction: Add a new variant { kind: "clear" } to the Command union. Leave everything else unchanged.
steps.interfaceChange: export type Command = { kind: "add"; title: string; due?: string; } | { kind: "complete"; id: number; } | { kind: "list"; } | { kind: "clear"; };

steps.instruction: Add a 'clear' command that removes all todos whose `done` field is true (the request calls this 'completed'). types will add the Command variant { kind: "clear" } (in parallel; assume it exists). 1) Export a pure function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[] that returns a new array with only the todos where done === false, in original order, with ids and all other fields unchanged (no renumbering), and does not mutate the input. 2) parseArgs(["clear"]) returns { kind: "clear" }. 3) run(path, { kind: "clear" }) loads todos from path, removes done todos, saves the result back to path, and returns the string `Cleared N` where N is the number of todos removed (e.g. "Cleared 1", "Cleared 0"). Clearing when nothing is done is not an error. Do not change existing behaviour of other commands.
steps.interfaceChange: export declare function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[];

input.reason: The request says "completed field", but Todo has no such field; the field that `complete` sets is `done`, so I read it as done === true. Add a Command variant in types; commands adds a pure clear(), parseArgs support, and run handling that saves the result and returns "Cleared N".
